image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ situated in a church or cathedral setting. The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple ranks of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The central section contains the tallest pipes, flanked by shorter ranks on either side. The casing is elaborately carved wood with gilded details and decorative moldings. Below the main pipe array, there is a console area (though partially obscured by foreground figures/objects) and lower structural elements. Two human figures in white robes are visible at the bottom center, providing scale.
